compute_honest_score: compute the HONEST score to measure hurtful sentence completions in language models using English lexicon
compute_honest_score_per_group: compute the HONEST score per group to compare hurtful completions across demographic groups like male and female
load_honest_multilingual: load the HONEST evaluation module for a specified language such as French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, or Romanian
strip_accent_from_string: strip accents from a string to normalize text before comparing against the HurtLex hurtful language lexicon
evaluate_hurtful_completions: evaluate model completions against the HurtLex lexicon to quantify hurtful word usage in word-level or sentence-level predictions
